messages:
anya: Quick design thought — introducing a "mini-footer" for compact modals (save/cancel inline with small density). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/mini-footer-proposal. Problems: focus gets clipped, small buttons look visually fine but don't meet 44px touch target, and success toast timing feels inconsistent with other flows.

sam: I like the visual but agree on a11y concerns. Don't reduce the interactive hit size. Suggest keeping visual 28px but add invisible hit padding around buttons. 

ira: +1 for hit padding. Also, modal footers sit inside containers with overflow:hidden; moving the footer out into an overflow-visible slot avoids clipping without changing shadows.

kai: avoid translateY hacks on icons. use inline-flex + align-items:center with explicit svg dims. example: ` .mini-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px } .mini-btn svg { width:14px; height:14px } `

anya: copy nit: change "Save" -> "Save changes" in compact footer so it's explicit. i'll add i18n key.

sam: toast durations should be tokens. propose: token.toast.short=1400ms, token.toast.medium=2400ms, token.toast.long=3600ms. success should at least be medium in modals so users see confirmation.

design-bot: proposed tokens created in branch: spacing.mini=6px, touch.hitPadding=8px, toast.duration.medium=2400ms. PR: #802. :robot_face:

ira: QA reminders — add visual regression snapshots for compact modal footer default/long-label/icon-only, test RTL, and add an automated a11y check that measures effective bounding box >=44px.

kai: also ensure toasts are rendered in a top-level portal (outside modal DOM) and use `aria-live=polite` so they don't steal focus.

anya: plan: update Figma, implement hit-wrapper, move footer to overflow-visible slot, remove svg nudges, update copy/i18n, and open PR with visual diffs + a11y test cases. aiming for next sprint. ping me for reviews.

sam: :thumbsup:
